projects.title: Sketchup + Enscape
projects.shortDesc: Photorealistic 3D architectural modeling, interior layouts, materials, and exterior lighting walkthrough visualizations.
projects.problemStatement: Clients and contractors often struggle to visualize spatial layout, lighting interplay, and material textures from standard 2D floor plans alone, leading to misinterpretations and costly construction modifications.
objectives: Translate 2D floor plans into a fully articulated 3D architectural model.
Design dynamic daylight and twilight illumination scenarios emphasizing modern facade elements.
Produce photorealistic interior visualizations for key residential spaces (living room, dining, master bedroom, youth bunk room, and balcony).
projects.methodology:
1. Imported verified 2D floor plans into SketchUp as base geometric templates.
2. Extruded exterior walls, floor slabs, parapets, and cantilevered balcony balconies.
3. Modeled interior elements: custom wooden staircase with glass railing, integrated TV wall cabinetry, and bunk beds.
4. Applied high-resolution PBR materials (wood grain, polished marble tiles, wall textures, glass transparency).
5. Set up Enscape real-time engine with accurate sun azimuth, artificial LED cove lighting, warm wall-sconces, and a backlit tree wall mural.
6. Rendered ultra-high-definition presentation views from strategic occupant eye-levels.
projects.contribution: Independently modeled all 3D geometries in SketchUp, curated textures and materials, established natural and architectural lighting schemes in Enscape, and rendered presentation plates.
projects.outcome: Delivered an immersive architectural visualization portfolio package praised for aesthetic warmth and realistic lighting, successfully demonstrating how design elements integrate harmoniously prior to construction.

Draft cross-sections through the staircase and sanitary zones to verify headrooms and vertical plumbing alignments.

2. Spatial distribution adhering to functional zoning: public living zones, dining, private bedrooms, and utility.

4. Generated detailed multi-directional elevations and longitudinal sections.
5. Prepared door-window schedules, carpet area statements, and compliance checklists.
projects.contribution: Formulated the architectural space plan, drafted all plans, sections, and elevations, implemented standardized layers and annotations, and verified conformity with local building development regulations.
projects.outcome: Produced a complete, contractor-ready working drawing set minimizing site queries and ensuring compliance with local approval standards.

3. Placed parametric doors, windows, curtain walls, floor slabs, and ceilings.
4. Generated automated schedules for doors, windows, and room areas.
5. Configured view templates and sheet layouts for professional documentation.
projects.contribution: Modeled the entire architectural BIM model, customized family parameters, organized view sheets, and extracted automated scheduling data.
projects.outcome: Eliminated drawing coordination errors and demonstrated efficient BIM workflows that streamline documentation and quantity estimation.

projects.title: Structural Modeling & Frame Analysis (STAAD.Pro)
projects.shortDesc: 3D space frame analysis of an RCC building under gravity loads following Indian Standard codes IS 456 & IS 875.
projects.problemStatement: Verifying structural safety, stability, and economy of member sizes against dead loads, superimposed finishes, and live occupancy loads.
objectives: Model 3D structural nodes, beams, and columns aligned with architectural grid spacing.
Assign concrete grade M25, rebar grade Fe500, and appropriate boundary restraint conditions.
Calculate and apply dead loads, wall loads, and slab floor loads per IS 875.\nEvaluate shear force (SFD), bending moment (BMD), and joint displacement envelopes.
projects.methodology:
1. Defined structural geometry using node coordinates and beam connectivity.
2. Assigned cross-sectional properties for beams ($230	imes 450	ext{ mm}$) and columns ($300	imes 450	ext{ mm}$).
3. Defined self-weight, masonry wall loads on beams ($12	ext{ kN/m}$), and floor live loads ($2	ext{ kN/m}^2$ & $3	ext{ kN/m}^2$).
4. Performed linear elastic static analysis.
5. Inspected critical member forces, maximum bending moments at mid-span, and shear forces at supports.
projects.contribution: Generated the 3D frame geometry in STAAD.Pro, assigned material and section properties, applied load combinations per IS codes, and validated member safety.
projects.outcome: Confirmed member stresses and deflections remained within permissible code limits, providing a safe and cost-effective structural framework.
